# Packages that changed their name: "old new", one a line. The one source of the old names
# (tools/pkgs.py reads it).
#   - every renamed ipk control and Packages entry carries Replaces, Conflicts and Provides: <old>,
#     so opkg removes the old package (running its prerm) before it installs the new one
#   - the new add-on install script renames an existing record drawer <old> to <new> first
#     (dist/common/check.dos and check-standalone.dos), and dist/Uninstall does the same, so an install made by
#     the old Installer is still found, updated and uninstalled
# The new name is column 2 of dist/packages.txt (tests/test_dist_packages.py holds the two to each
# other). Product names (C:Claude, C:amiga-pi, SYS:Python3) and the base UP-Term do not change.
Claude        up-claude
amiga-pi      up-pi
UP-Term-nvim  up-nvim
Python3       up-python
UP-Term-git   up-git
UP-Term-perl  up-perl
UP-Term-vim   up-vim
